name: Sölderhof
beschreibung:
Overview

The Hotel Sölderhof is located in the heart of Sölden in the Ötztal valley in Tirol, at an altitude of 1,368 metres. The Riml family's house is situated on a quiet side street in the Waldele district and at the same time only about five minutes' walk from the Giggijochbahn. According to Bergfex, the hotel has around 80 beds. Guests stay in one of three room categories – Sölderhof, Sölden and Nederkogel – or in one of the Apartments Ötztal and Tirol. The facilities include a hotel bar, a lounge area, a seminar room for around 30 people and a wellness area with sauna, steam bath and whirlpools. A large car park is available directly at the house, and Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel.

History/Background

Reliable information on the founding history of the house is not documented in the available sources. What is certain is that it is a family business of the Riml family, who according to their own statements are deeply rooted in Sölden and the Ötztal and, in addition to the Sölderhof, run further hotels, mountain huts, restaurants and sports shops. Several areas of the house have been modernised; for example, the spacious rooms in the Sölden category have renovated bathrooms with a bathtub and shower screen; the rooms are equipped with a radio, TV and balcony.

Arrival

The Sölderhof is located at Waldelestraße 2, 6450 Sölden. Guests are only around five minutes' walk from the village centre and from the valley station of the Giggijochbahn, which makes the accommodation a good starting point for winter and summer activities. A large car park is located directly at the house. With the Ötztal Inside Summer Card, which is included for the duration of the stay, public bus services throughout the Ötztal can be used free of charge.

Tips

The Half-board Premium Kulinarium includes a breakfast buffet with an organic corner, types of bread from the local baker, cold cuts and cheeses as well as homemade jams. Dinner with included drinks such as beer, wine and soft drinks is served between 18:30 and 21:00, with Tuesday as a rest day. Sauna, steam bath and whirlpools provide relaxation after a day in the mountains. According to the provider, the seminar room is suitable for groups of around 30 people. There is also the advantage of the Summer Card with free ascent and descent on the summer mountain lifts in the Ötztal.

Best Travel Time

Sölden is a year-round destination. In winter the focus is on the ski area around the Giggijochbahn, while in summer hiking trails, mountain bike and e-bike routes as well as the mountain landscape of the Ötztal are the main attractions. A blanket recommendation for individual months cannot be derived from the sources.
